description.p: wLib keeps your F95Zone games in one place. It tells you when a game has an update, helps you install it, and launches it for you.

This Flatpak runs the manager interface in a sandbox, but games and runners (Wine, Proton, winetricks, archive extractors and native game binaries) run on the host system, using the host tools and the shared library at ~/.local/share/wLib. Host filesystem and host command execution access are required.
